name: Mirage ~In'en no Shokushu Byoutou~ Another Story Of D'erlanger
original_name: Mirage～淫宴の触手病棟～ Another Story Of D'ERLANGER
source:
This is another story of "D'erlanger". Yui is hospitalized for a sudden illness at Seihou Hospital. One night, when she wakes up, she finds herself in a nightmare world "Mirage". She walks around the hospital and encounters mysterious monsters.... Somehow, she is saved by men who fight against monsters with special ability. A man tells her that endless battles between humans and monsters are taken place in "Mirage" and she is forced to be a sex slave for those men who fight against monsters because she has no special ability to protect herself. One night, here comes a new woman, Kikukawa. She tries to destroy the relationships among men and they start to fight against one another. All the men are annihilated and Kikukawa is also gone somewhere....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090213111913/http://erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1004008]Eroge Shop[/url]]
